[h2][b]Hello Chefs![/b]👨‍🍳[/h2]

Are you ready for more improvements in Cooking Simulator? 😍

[h3][b]Base[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] The perk selection UI is now more visible in PerkHUB app
[/list]
[h3][b]C&C[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The dough can no longer clip, and disappears upon transferring from one kneading bowl to another container
[*] Pan x kneading bowl camera adjustment
[/list]
[h3][b]Sushi[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] FPS improvement while making tempura mix
[*] The order archives now reset every day
[*] The oil model is no longer sticking out of the frying machine

[/list]
[h3][b]Check out what’s new, download the latest update, and cook up something delicious![/b] 🍽️[/h3]

notes.title: Update 6.0.13: Cooking Simulator Winter Update & Sale
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hi Chefs! 👨‍🍳[/b][/h2]

We hope you're enjoying the holidays! On our end, we've got a special treat for you: our winter update!

This update includes a new feature and many bug fixes, so check out the summary in the image below, or keep reading for the juicy details!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/deaeebd029766919482ee2e99354a88de87a5c2a.jpg[/img]


[h2]Sushi DLC Update: Gotcha Shop[/h2]

The most significant change we've made is introducing the Gotcha Shop in the Sushi DLC! This feature unlocks after you reach the maximum player level (i.e., achieving Black Belt). Here, you can buy points for the Gotcha! App. We hope this will help players unlock all of the recipes in the Sushi DLC and fully experience all that it has to offer.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/473bf14fb30f70ac0d09a68237aaba447e7ca661.png[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes [/h2]

The fun doesn't stop with the Gotcha Shop though. We've thoroughly seasoned this version of the game with several bug fixes! Keep reading to learn about what's changed:

[h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved Vsync functionality
[*] Added Winter Theme to the main menu background and music
[/list]
[h3][b]Base Game[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] “A winner!” achievement will unlock properly now, only after receiving 1st place in a contest
[*] Fixed score calculation for contest mode
[*] It should now be possible to upgrade recipes with Custom Menu enabled
[*] The following recipes have had their criteria and/or descriptions updated to facilitate obtaining a 5-star rating when cooking them:
[list]   
[*] Fruit Salad
[*] Cowboy Steak with Baked Potato and Broccoli
[*] Grilled Cabbage Burger
[*] Chicken Pumpkin Stew
[*] Chicken Pumpkin Stew with Tomatoes
[*] Orange Pork Stir-Fry
[*] Pork Chops with Fried Egg and Lemon Baked Potatoes
[*] Chunky Gazpacho
[*] Ukrainian Borscht
[*] Pork Chops and Lemon Baked Potatoes
[*] Honey-Mustard Burger with French Fries
[*] Duck Breast with Apples
[*] Currant-Glazed Pork Tenderloin with Red Cabbage and Thyme Dumplings
[*] Ukrainian Borscht with Boiled Egg
[*] Sweet and Sour Pork
[*] Marinated Sweet and Sour Pork
[/list]
[/list]
[h3][b]Sushi DLC[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a gacha points shop app that unlocks after reaching max level in career mode - you can now buy points to unlock remaining recipes (as mentioned previously)
[*] Vege Kanpyo Abo recipe can now be unlocked in Gotcha! App
[*] Fixed a bug that caused icons in the recipes list in Gotcha! App to not display sometimes
[*] Improved customer feedback for served dishes in day end summary
[*] Improved pouring of loose products (e.g., rice)
[*] Dish summary improvements
[*] Tweaks to the pace of progression
[*] Fixed a bug that caused “Recipe unlocked” notifications to show when they should not
[*] Maki should display correct heat treatment for fried mackerel
[*] Inedible items should no longer be destroyed in the process of making tempura
[*] Equalized the rewards for recipes served for special clients and regular clients
[/list]
[h3][b]Pizza DLC[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Zucchini will no longer fall through all surfaces
[*] Improved visibility for hovered buttons in Perk App
[*] Fixed bug where homemade sauce text was not localized properly
[*] Avocado, Bell peppers, and Eggplant spawners should display properly regardless of which DLCs are purchased
[/list]
[h3][b]Cakes & Cookies DLC[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause a white square to cover half of the phone screen
[/list]
[h3][b]Shelter DLC[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause multiple, various issues that was triggered by entering context at the end of the day
[/list]

[h2]What's a holiday without a gift?[/h2]

Are you still hungry for more? Don't worry, we've got some dessert for you too! To celebrate the holidays, we're offering massive discounts on Cooking Simulator and all of the DLC!
Give the gift of cooking to a friend, or complete your collection and buy any DLC you've been interested in. We hope that everyone enjoys the holidays and the new year!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/3df3364a634a132680aa42b9594c3e9172b2049c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Community Feedback in Action: Join us on Discord[/h2]

After reviewing the results of our recent survey and your feedback, we're prioritizing updates that reflect what matters most to you. Over the next few months, we’ll be focusing on fixing bugs, reworking some core mechanics and adding new content inspired by your suggestions.

Some of these changes are already in development, so stay tuned for more updates. Thank you for taking the time to share your thoughts and we're looking forward to hearing more of your ideas.

If you'd like your voice to be heard or hear the latest news, we encourage you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/y4yQBudhMG]Discord server[/url] to share your feedback, report bugs or get some sneak peeks of what's coming to Cooking Simulator. We've recently refreshed our Discord server to better serve you, and hope to see you there sharing your Cooking Simulator experience with us and the community. Your feedback helps us make Cooking Simulator better for everyone.


[url=https://discord.gg/y4yQBudhMG][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/4c12181ba6b810a3e99e123ca5e7412d5f51a77c.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]Happy Holidays![/h2]

We wish you a joyful holiday season and a fantastic New Year. Thank you for being part of our community—we’re looking forward to an exciting year ahead together!

[h2]From all of us at Big Cheese Studio[/h2]
[h2]Merry Christmas, Happy Holidays, and Happy New Year![/h2]

[b]Hi Chefs![/b]👨‍🍳

[b]Thank you[/b] for such a great interest in our new [b]DLC Cooking Simulator: Sushi.[/b]🎉

While we work on giving you the best cooking experience possible [b]we would like to start revealing and sharing some of the game insights with you! [/b]

[i]And we would like to start with some brand new appliances that our team designed especially for this DLC.[/i] They are [b]MUST HAVES[/b] in the [b]Sushi Chef’s kitchen[/b].

[h3][b]NEW KNIVES!🔪[/b] [/h3]
One of the most important kitchen tools in the hands of every sushi master. Their precision blade, exceptional sharpness, balance and durability make them irreplaceable for different tasks such as cutting fish and maki.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/b8da77d838480d975d31897cafa8bd88a26fbf5c.png[/img]

Perfectly cooked rice is fundamental in making any form of sushi and this machine is of real help in the kitchen. You just have to put the right portion of it inside, wait for a little while and then it’s ready. Remember to rinse it first!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/4e614b31f65d8407f1607146d0c3bbe6c067bdb2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/7c9db7719beb61dfcedf8e73b5c77df9cf31fa77.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/b2bea75237b5659f0c8a0a5d3a91506f0a0c83aa.png[/img]

Hi Chefs!

Winter Holiday is just around the corner! To help you celebrate that special time of the year usually spent bonding with each other, we'd like to invite you to check out the [b]beta version[/b] of the Poltergeist Multiplayer mode.

Yes, you've heard that right. Poltergeist is a holiday-themed multiplayer mode for Cooking Simulator. [b]Just keep in mind that it's still in a very early beta stage, so  definitely expect some bugs while messing around with your friends.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/04ae0c51dede2a13c301d0dfdc8e15e203a9f481.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]How to access beta:[/b][/h3]
1. Right-click on 'Cooking Simulator' in your Steam library and go to 'Properties'
2. In the new window left-click ‘BETAS’ from the left side panel
3. Choose ‘poltergeist’ from the drop-down list
4. Close the window and update the game

[b]IMPORTANT:[/b] The beta contains only the Poltergeist game mode! If you want to access the regular Cooking Simulator game modes, you’ll need to opt out from beta. By using the instruction above, choose ‘none’ from the drop-down list.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/82c98d25f0cde99263f53a9f04ccbb471f3a6b53.png[/img]


Poltergeist Multiplayer mode allows for [b]up to 4 players[/b] sharing the Classic kitchen and preparing dishes. You'll see each other as friendly ghosts flying across the kitchen. Due to the game's nature some of the interactions are limited. [b]You can cooperate by exchanging products and ready made-dishes by using the shared space on the table right in the middle of the kitchen.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/d1026a03c52e54288a4e32b0f6152310ba753bf1.jpg[/img]


[h3]Poltergeist offers 2 game modes:[/h3]
[b]Sandbox[/b] - learn and practice your cooking skills with any pressure or scoring
[b]Leaderboards[/b] - work together to prepare the chosen dishes during the given time and earn the highest score possible


If you'd like to share some feedback or find other players to cook with, make sure to join our official discord server:
[url=discord.gg/bigcheesestudio]discord.gg/bigcheesestudio[/url]

Have fun cooking together!

notes.title: Shelter Devlog #3 | Hunting and farming
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/b91cb06c4dddc7ce6488c44c0ccd1f6da3e216ed.jpg[/img]

Hi Chefs!

Shelter release is just around the corner. Below is the latest devlog dedicated to some of the new mechanics - hunting and farming!

As you might already know, Shelter due to its post-apocalyptic setting is all about being resourceful and making the most out of every opportunity and scarce resources. That's why keeping the old mechanics of instantly buying everything we might need for cooking wouldn't make that much sense in the barren wastelands.

The food products can be obtained in one of 3 ways:
[list]
[*] hunting mutants and harvesting their meat 
[*] growing plants in an underground farm 
[*] ordering additional products from the caravan travelling across the Sector
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/3e86d50074c3e06909911bb4291a3c39e23f0460.png[/img]

The main source of protein will be the meat harvested from 3 species of mutants roaming the desert: rats, armadillos and vultures. During the day we can climb to the shed above our shelter and use it as a hunting range. Shooting is definitely a mechanic you wouldn't expect from a Cooking Simulator game but we tried to make it as interesting and engaging as possible. The gun will feature 4 upgrades:
[list]
[*] Scope
[*] Silencer
[*] Magazine
[*] Extended barrel
[/list]
Those can be unlocked by progressing the accessible immediately in Sandbox mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/c80f7099c8167ccbfebf4838f79708389d375d46.png[/img]

Some quests might require us to maintain the mutants' population at a certain level. Killing too many might result in reduced numbers and longer time required to repopulate again. Mutants can be attracted by using makeshift lures which will attract certain types of creatures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/7299be53d10f3e2486dbeee6b9f81303417beba9.png[/img]

Meat is not the only type of food available in the wastelands. As mentioned in one of the previous entries, we wanted to look at the post-apocalyptic setting as an opportunity to introduce intriguing, colorful and vibrant plant-based foods. The following products can be grown in the underground farm:
[list]
[*] Broccoli
[*] Leek
[*] Cactus
[*] Celery
[*] Tomato
[*] Carrot
[*] Blue mushroom
[*] Red mushroom
[*] Green mushroom 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/c74400dd3414a86e91206c6ad5955973bafba0cc.png[/img]

After planting the seeds, watering and using optional boosters there's a 1-day long growing period after which the plants are ready for harvest. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/2ea3b6cb499af425977e7dc0685f3b0639a5d6c9.png[/img]

Unfortunately one of the side effects of living in an irradiated wasteland are random mutations which can turn our seeds into carnivorous plants. In such a case, the only thing left to do is grabbing our gun to clear the spot for future plants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/f326825a19e8840b0a043f49bac3a894d11288a3.png[/img]

There are a lot of recipes to master and most of them require more products than can be obtained on our own. The initial supplies can be restocked with the help of the caravan travelling across the Sector.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/ffccd3ab6ac1107a10f7d326b2b6f0c4777f8a52.png[/img]

[list]

[*] Microwave should no longer heat up products that were pulled out of it
[*] Mint is no longer painting surfaces red

[*] Fixed issue causing fridge doors’ weird reactions when colliding with objects
[/list]
[b]Pizza[/b]
[list]
[*] Added missing Chinese characters
[*] Player should be able to properly progress in tutorial when using a gamepad
[*] Player should no longer be able to buy products when bankrupt
[*] Fixed bug causing player not to be able to properly navigate pizza decoration view while using gamepad

[*] Inserting large objects into grater machine should no longer cause them to bounce off of the lid
[*] Loading game no longer causes empty jars to fill up

[*] Decorating pizza should no longer cause product parts to jitter or land out of pizza
[*] Fixed issue causing scrolling of both decoration size and pinned recipe/order at the same time
[*] Reducing the amount of collision caused by interactions related to pizza peel
[*] Throwing all shopping boxes out of window now results in a new one spawning inside
[*] Pinning recipe in order details view is now binded to the correct key
[*] Added missing input hint for pad in order view in phone
[*] Player should now be able to scroll recipe when in pizza creation view
[*] Added two mops to the kitchen
[*] Fixed an error during pizza checkout
[*] Changed fuel deplate speed in various scenarios
[/list]
[b]Cakes and Cookies[/b]
[list]
[*] Loose products like flour should now create stains on the floor
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause bought items to never be delivered
[*] Info at the end of the day should now properly update
[*] Fixed bug causing toppings on cakes to be invisible
[*] Various optimizations
[*] Player should be able to remove custom made frostings
[/list]

We hope you're going to have tons of fun with the latest update! ❤️❤️❤️

Join our Discord and let us know how you like the changes:

notes.title: Cakes and Cookies decorating update! 🧁🎨
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/f141df6ffc6c6183d22c78d021721a9b7ee5a439.png[/img]


Hi Chefs!
Here's another promised update for Cakes and Cookies. 
We wanted to give you more ways to unleash your creativity and also streamline the decorating process a little more.

This new update contains 84 new figurines divided into 7 sets: Bats and clubs, Holiday Bundle, Cars Bundle, Home Pets Bundle, Oceans Bundle, Leaves Bundle, One-wheelers Bundle. To grab them, aim at the drawer and press E. The new figurines can be found at the bottom of the list.


Additionally, we've improved the icing/frosting mechanics. From now on the spatula contains more portions of the chosen product, allowing you to decorate up to 4 cookies or 1 cake. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/91574b16731ad0d48a642757900c727141ee3a46.gif[/img]


There's also a new icing/frosting container with 20 portions capacity which can be moved around the confectionery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/9ac70e82d157cdbebf110ae4ef9dae6dbee0854a.gif[/img]


You've been also asking us to make it easier to carry smaller pastries around. To improve that part of the game we've added bake trays which can be used to transport multiple cookies or cakes at the same time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/5e9cbb4c9b612244032abe9db824600d16ebf348.gif[/img]


Also, make sure to check out Tutori - a brand new app in the smartphone which gives you instant access to all the ingame tutorials!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/946bfdeb62860aaf637a5263d3e1be4ab96b24b6.png[/img]

[b]Added:[/b]
- Added Frosting Container, which allows for carrying up to 20 icing/frosting portions
- Added Baking Tray for carrying multiple cakes and cookies at the same time
- Increased Confectionery Spatula capacity. From now on, when fully filled, it allows for spreading icing/frosting on up to 4 cookies or 1 cake
- Added 7 new figurine bundles containing 84 new figurines: Bats and clubs, Holiday Bundle, Cars Bundle, Home Pets Bundle, Oceans Bundle, Leaves Bundle, One-wheelers Bundle

- Fixed Advanced Buying lesson in the Cooking School. Avocado Oil can now be purchased
- Fixed bug, which caused the display of wrong temperatures for certain doughs (e.g. 140C instead of 150C)
- Fixed bug related to wrong work behavior of oven when repaired after save & load. Occasionally it was heating with the doors unlocked, and not heating with the doors closed
- Fixed possible hashtags conflicts in special orders (eg. Nut and Nut-Free hashtags in single order)
- Fixed ug: player losing input after throwing out products from the containers into trash
- Fixed bug: cake layer is still highlighted after picking it up from a stack of cakes
- Fixed animation bug: when filling the measuring cup, the fill level starts around half height and drops slightly before going up again
- Fixed bug: clicking on dispenser with measuring cup instantly fills it with 25g of nothing (next attempt to fill measuring cup fills it to 50g with selected product)
- Fluid inside a mixer container is displayed properly when it's more than ~50% full
- Fixed bug: meltable products were occasionally disappearing after skipping the time
- Fixed not moving forms and kneading machine tools placed inside the drawers after load the game
- Fixed bug: occasionally disappearing objects in the Kneading Machine Container
- Fixed bug: purchase button and cart value don't react to changes in shop cart and total player money
- Fixed bug: receiving package from the door doesn't lower notifications counter value
- Doughnuts can be now picked up with a container from the deep fryer without increasing the pick range first
- Fixed bug: extra dough that doesn’t fit in the Dough Dispenser disappears
- Kneading machine stand fixes when trying to knead egg shells. Occasionally it was not responding to the player’s actions
- Cake pans will work properly when filled with dough by clicking on the pans’ sides


[b]Changed:[/b]
- Improved freshly kneaded cake scale. It was too big compared to its volume
- Rotated all the figurines, so that they will be facing the player when picked up
- Improved fluid behavior in cake forms
- Disabled money UI, which was shown when purchasing loose products and frostings/icings in Sandbox mode

Happy baking!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/aaabc9ab9d7e1b6461b2a922b98509994e7cd0a2.png[/img]
This new patch contains a huge number of various bug fixes and gameplay improvements. Happy New Year, Chefs! Thank you for 2019, let's keep making the game even better in 2020. For a great start, the game's on -25% discount for the next 2 weeks.

[b]Psst! Want to know a secret? There's a new expansion on the way! More info next week :)[/b]

[h1]Full list of changes[/h1]
[b]General:[/b][list]
[*] Game loading time has been reduced
[*] Improved adding products into moving containers
[*] Improved collisions for Spring Onion
[*] Fixed the scroll indicator's position for the list of products in a container
[*] Improved achievement 'You missed a spot'
[*] Fixed the animations for trashcans
[*] Improved particle effects for pouring water in still containers
[*] Added missing hints for product spawners
[*] Added missing cursor icon for the cutting board and cutting products 
[*] Beer barrel can no longer be clicked on while pouring beer into beer mug
[*] Player can no longer gather Cooking Points after sending out an empty plate
[*] In-game screens will now have applied all the graphic effects in Photomode and endgame screen
[*] Hint 'Switch stacking' has been removed when highlighting an empty container
[*] All meat and fish products will now cut properly
[*] Improved performance for Steady Hands perk
[*] The timer sounds will no longer be played with muted audio
[*] Fixed an error that caused the fridge door to occasionally open in the wrong direction
[*] Fixed issues related to cutting T-Bone Steak

[*] Pork Breakfast Sausage from now on will fry and grill on both sides

[*] Store can no longer be entered while sending out a dish and during the end of the day
[*] Fixed an issue that played  sounds for putting down objects after loading the game

[/list]

[b]Leaderboards:[/b][list]
[*] Missing products have been added on the shelf

[*] Recipe Chicken Tikka Masala - Fenugreek Leaves spawns on the scene
[*] Recipe Chicken Tikka Masala with Potatoes - Fenugreek Leaves spawns on the scene
[/list]

[b]Other game modes:[/b][list]
[*] FoodNetwork - fixed a bug that duplicated recipes from Food Network DLC

[*] FoodNetwork - 'Exit' sign near the audience has been repositioned to not collide with the player
[*] Classic and Food Network - yellow sticky notes have been removed to increase the game's performance

And a number of minor fixes that didn't make it on the list :)

notes.title: Cooking Simulator Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/9e8c833fe92fce768e54e8ef01f3984fd696ef1c.png[/img]

[b]Hi Chefs![/b]

The dev team is hard at work to constantly improve Cooking Simulator. Today we want to shed some light on things that we are up to and when to expect them. 

This is why we're very excited to present to you the [b]Cooking Simulator Roadmap[/b]. First in a [b]series of announcements[/b] spotlighting features and content currently [b]under development[/b]. It's also a way of letting you know [b]when to expect[/b] new content and important messages.

[b][h1]THE ROADMAP[/h1][/b]
Today's spotlight is on two major content updates coming to the game [b]for FREE[/b] in the next few weeks! But before you scroll down to learn the details, mark down [b]6th of December[/b] in your calendars. That's the date of our [b]next big announcement[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/d301f79a319eb5daadb483d5b75a23836501be66.png[/img]

- What about features that aren't on the list? Does this mean you aren't working on anything else? - Rest assured, [b]we're exploring all kinds of different topics[/b] - from bugfixing, through optimisation, new content, new game modes to entirely new ways to experience Cooking Simulator. What we decide to share through the roadmap are features that we can put a specific timeframe on. [b]We don't want to tease you too much[/b] ;)

[b][h1]MODERN KITCHEN[/h1][/b]
Many of you have spent hours upon hours in Cooking Simulator's kitchen and [b]you need a change[/b] - we hear you! Staying in one place for too long can have it's toll. So on 21st of November we'll introduce a [b]new location[/b] to hang out and cook all that delicious food. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/78454547dabb5b0324d0da08d2b3514883e61cbc.jpg[/img]

Tired of the same old brick walls and all the noise coming from the streets? Try the [b]Modern Kitchen[/b] - a new fancy place located in a [b]luxury skyscraper[/b], detached from the racket of the city. Modern Kitchen will become available in career and sandbox modes (requires starting a new game) as [b]a FREE update[/b] to the game.

[b][h1]LEADERBOARD CHALLENGE[/h1][/b]
Ever wanted to prove that you are [b]the best chef around[/b]? Well, soon you will be able to! Pick an order from all the dishes available in the game and take to the kitchen. No distractions, just one simple goal - [b]serve the best dish you can[/b], the fastest you can. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/adb7e7ceed4ef6a9f745123bc0919f996ad1618b.png[/img]

Based on this performance, the game will calculate your score and place you on a leaderboard. [b]Each recipe will have its own leaderboard[/b]. Become an expert in one or master them all. Rivalry begins on 4th of December with [b]a FREE update[/b] to the game.

[b][h1]SECRET ANNOUNCEMENT[/h1][/b]
But that's not all! We have another [b]very important announcement[/b] coming for you on December the 6th. Be sure to mark down that date and [b]visit our community page[/b] on Steam. We won't tease what we have in store for you - don't want to spoil the surprise, you'll have to be patient. But [b]feel free to speculate[/b] in comments, on the forums and on our Discord: https://discord.gg/cookingsimulator

Also be sure to let us know what you think about the upcoming features and this format of revealing them!

Hope you'll have a great time with the new content!
Cooking Simulator Dev Team

notes.title: Cooking Simulator FAQ
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29063568/e5e6277f5f1f713f7c754b36c2ac7fff14274627.png[/img]
[h1]Hey Chefs![/h1]
Below you can find answers to some of the most commonly asked questions regarding the game and it's future. Please read :)

[h1]Cooking Simulator FAQ[/h1]
[b]1. Are you going to add more content? More dishes, kitchens, utensils, mechanics? DLC?[/b]
Yes, of course! Right now our main focus is patching the game and fixing any issues. We're releasing patches frequently so we can start working on extra content ASAP.  We promise to update you with more information regarding new features as soon as we've got any details confirmed. Stay tuned!

[b]1.1 We want a ladde! Are you guys going to add a ladle?[/b]
Yes! It's coming sooner than you'd think :)

[b]2. VR?[/b]
Right now our main focus is patching the game. We know that you guys would love VR and so do we! As soon as we've got some solid info, we'll let you know.

[b]3. Multiplayer/Co-Op?[/b]
We're 100% aware that you guys would love to have it. The game was designed as a single player experience and we'll need to check if and in what form it's possible. We're considering it but we just need a little more time before we can say anything for sure.

[b]4. More platforms? PS4, XBOX ONE, MAC?[/b]
We're considering it but can't confirm anything yet :)

[b]5. Is my PC going to run the game?[/b]
Please check the requirements on the Steam store page.
Alternatively, you can use this site: https://www.systemrequirementslab.com/cyri/requirements/cooking-simulator/18846

[b]5.1 How can I check my PC specs?[/b]
Follow these steps:
  1. Press Win + R
  2. Type in "dxdiag.exe"
  3. Press Enter

[b]6. I can't save my game/my game is stuck on 'Saving' screen in tutorial, what to do?[/b]
Try these possible solutions:
[list]
[*] In most cases, the antivirus is responsible for this. You can turn it off or add a game as an exception
[*] If the point above doesn't help: Open steam -> Library -> Right Click on Cooking Simulator -> Properties -> Local Files -> Browse local files -> Right Click on CookingSim.exe -> Compatibility -> Check Run this program as an Administrator
[*] Next go to: Security -> Select your username -> Edit -> Check Full control -> Apply -> Ok
[*] If the problem still exists, ask the developers. It's best to find us on our discord server: https://discord.gg/7m8UZyM
[/list]
[b]7. How can I access the latest update?[/b]
We publish new patches on the beta branch and once they're approved they're transferred onto the default branch.
How to access the beta branch:
1 .Go to your Steam Library
2. Right-click on Cooking Simulator and select "Properties"
3. Go to the tab marked "Betas"
4. In the drop-down box, select "beta"
5. Wait for the game to finish updating, you should see the branch name listed after the game name.

[b]8. I need some tech support![/b]
Feel free to talk to us on our official discord server. We usually need some more info before we can start working on a fix for you.
https://discord.gg/7m8UZyM

[b]9. I've found a translation error! Where can I report it?[/b]
The best place is our discord server: https://discord.gg/7m8UZyM
Great guys from our community are proofreading all the translations. Feel free to join them :)

[b]10. Are there going to be more languages available?[/b]
Yes! Currently we're working on Japanese. Also, our lovely community is preparing Czech, Dutch, Hungarian and Lithuanian <3

[b]11. How can I add my own radio stations or music?[/b]
You can add radio stations by pasting URL in the Audio settings. 
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29063568/aa9441891ed2d21b8407119f58753f9ce90e6464.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29063568/b0aed5bf93c37d80fd57f3c79741e21ca71321c0.png[/img][/url]
Follow this video on how to get the URL: https://youtu.be/giz9eOSubgY
You can play your own music by pasting it's folder path in audio settings or by pasting the files into the path shown on the screen above.

[b]12. I can't flip stuff! Can you help me?[/b]
The game mechanics require some getting used to. You flip either in context mode or manually by holding shift and rotating the spatula. You can also buy a Heatproof Gloves perk and do it with your bare hands.

notes.title: Release in 1 week! Major announcement!
notes.content:
[h1]Cooking Simulator will be available on Steam on June 6th![/h1]
The game's coming next week and we couldn't be more excited for the release. 
The whole team has been working very hard every single day to deliver the best game possible for all of us to enjoy. In the recent months, thanks to your feedback and suggestions, there have been added some major improvements to the game. Below you can see the list of all the features.

[h1]COOKING MECHANICS BASED ON REALISTIC PHYSICS[/h1]
First of all, this game is not a "clicker". Whenever you're cooking or fooling around, there's always physics applied in the background. When making french fries, the potatoes split exactly at the cut line. Steaks on the griddle fry exactly where they touch it's surface. Food can be blended and turned into liquid. Liquids can mix together, change colour, temperature and exchange flavours. In fact all the food exchanges flavour all the time in the process. The dishes you make are being rated based on correct technique, temperature, ingredient proportions and preparation time.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29063568/e17bdbd9d59706aa5ab8d6fc569b808aaebbdff5.gif[/img]

[h1]COOKING SCHOOL[/h1]
It is basically a set of short tutorials. The game's got a learning curve and the mechanics need a tiny bit of time to get used to. The optional tutorials should make your start as painless as possible :)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29063568/5ea47edf40372fbaa85190c77dcd9f3227b56de5.gif[/img]

[h1]CAREER MODE[/h1]
You'll start your cooking career as a new chef in a restaurant that didn't perform so well in the past. After the first introductional days (don't worry, they're totally skippable!), you'll start serving dishes on your own. At first you'll have only 3 positions in the menu but as you progress, you'll be able to unlock new more advanced recipes. Your goal is to reach  5 Fame Stars. Once you reach top fame level, you can continue playing to unlock all the recipes and win all competitions or you can start a new career to see how well you'd do with other perks and skills selected.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29063568/a850b1485d38eb66bd064c7326bdae9b61e86309.gif[/img]

[h1]CAREER PROGRESS[/h1]
In order to progress, you'll need to do multiple tasks at once and deliver on time various well-made dishes. While climbing the culinary ladder, you'll need to mind your finances. Money allows you to buy ingredients and new utensils but it is also used to pay for necessary repairs of broken stands. For chefs who do well financially there's even an option to redecorate the kitchen! Well served guests will happily tip you but in case you really mess up, they might ask for a refund! 
You'll also have to please food critics and complete day-long cooking events. Each day you can complete simple Daily Quests for some EXP boost. There are total 20 experience levels that allow you to select perks and skills. Perks are active abilities that have huge impact on the gameplay while skills have a more subtle passive influence.
Throughout the career you'll be able to unlock over 60 dishes and over 120 ingredients (products, liquids, spices and herbs). 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29063568/211b8c414a76881cb2abdd99044811561d448f69.gif[/img]

[h1]SANDBOX MODE[/h1]
For those of you who need instant access to all the good stuff, who don't like to be bothered by hungry customers or clocks ticking and for those of you who just want to goof around with absolutely no consequences we've got the Sandbox Mode. You can do virtually WHATEVER you want in this mode. 
[list]
[*] Try out every single recipe? [b]Check![/b] 
[*] Use any ingredients to create something unique? Ingenious culinary inventions or disgusting deep fried monstrosities? [b]Check![/b] 
[*] Play with lifelike physics and do all the things you couldn't or shouldn't even try to do in your own kitchen? Blow up the oven and set the floor on fire? [b]Check![/b] 
[*] Mess with the gravity and make all the mess you've made float around like it's outer space? [b]Well... Check![/b]
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29063568/2c54796a07634def8b883a34b87052dc0488aa3e.gif[/img]

[h1]IMPORTANT INFO[/h1]
[list]
[*] Upon release the game will be available in the following languages: English, German, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Polish, Portuguese (Brazilian), Russian, French, Italian, Korean and Turkish
[*] On the day of release we'll be running [b]24h developer stream[/b] with the whole team. We hope to have some good time playing the game with you. Let us know, how much you're excited for the idea!
[*] We'll continue to support the game during and after the release. We'll do our best to help you as much as we can with any issues you might encounter. Later on, we'll start working on more content depending on your responses end expectations :)
[/list]

[h1]tl'dr[/h1] 
[b]Cooking Simulator is coming on Thursday June 6th at the price of $19.99 and we're super excited for the release![/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29063568/bd2060d9522aa76f3ff70c84eb70c1ff8a17fcad.gif[/img]
See you soon,
Cooking Simulator Dev Team

While climbing the culinary ladder, you'll need to mind your finances.
Money allows you to buy ingredients and new utensils but it is also used to pay for necessary repairs of broken stands.
For chefs who do well financially there's even an option to redecorate the kitchen!
Well served guests will happily tip you but in case you really mess up, they might ask for a refund!
You'll also have to please food critics and complete day-long cooking events.
Each day you can complete simple Daily Quests for some EXP boost.
There are total 20 experience levels that allow you to select perks and skills.
Perks are active abilities that have huge impact on the gameplay while skills have a more subtle passive influence.
Throughout the career you'll be able to unlock over 60 dishes and over 120 ingredients (products, liquids, spices and herbs).

For those of you who need instant access to all the good stuff, who don't like to be bothered by hungry customers or clocks ticking and for those of you who just want to goof around with absolutely no consequences we've got the Sandbox Mode.
You can do virtually WHATEVER you want in this mode.
Try out every single recipe? [b]Check![/b]
Use any ingredients to create something unique? Ingenious culinary inventions or disgusting deep fried monstrosities? [b]Check![/b]
Play with lifelike physics and do all the things you couldn't or shouldn't even try to do in your own kitchen? Blow up the oven and set the floor on fire? [b]Check![/b]
Mess with the gravity and make all the mess you've made float around like it's outer space? [b]Well... Check![/b]
Upon release the game will be available in the following languages: English, German, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Polish, Portuguese (Brazilian), Russian, French, Italian, Korean and Turkish
On the day of release we'll be running [b]24h developer stream[/b] with the whole team.
We hope to have some good time playing the game with you.
Let us know, how much you're excited for the idea!
We'll continue to support the game during and after the release.
We'll do our best to help you as much as we can with any issues you might encounter.
Later on, we'll start working on more content depending on your responses end expectations :)

notes.content:
[b]Dear Chefs![/b]

We'd like to let you know how the development is progressing. You're asking us many questions and keep showing great interest in our game. [b]Thank you[/b] for that!

[b]FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New cutting mechanic[/b] According to various comments and suggestions, we've added a feature that allows to cut more precisely by "freezing" the products on the cutting board. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29063568/b58d79289681034226cec6f9e1781d0752de4130.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Eggs![/b] Many of you've been asking to include eggs in the game. They're still work in progress but they're coming. Implementing them is a challenge since all the components like the shell, yolk and egg white react in a completely different way to physics but we're doing it!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29063568/7ae816370159ffe630331849dacec485b08ac0bb.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Sounds[/b] We've basically added a ton of sound effects! More are still coming.
[/list]


[b]FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Cooking School [/b] We've fully implemented a series of tutorials introducing the game mechanics and objectives. It explains the basics like how to use the tools, how to use the laptop, how to buy items, etc. One of the tutorials will guide you step by step through preparing an example dish.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29063568/5ea47edf40372fbaa85190c77dcd9f3227b56de5.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Physics[/b] Mostly collisions and liquids. The game applies physics to everything that's going on in the kitchen so we really want to have that part polished.

[*] [b]User Interface[/b] Adjustments and bug fixes.

[*] [b]Recipes and game balance[/b] All the planned recipes have been fully implemented. We're making sure that the game's challenging but not frustrating. We're optimizing the recipes by adjusting preparation requirements, time to complete the dish and the review system.
[/list]

[b]WHAT ELSE?[/b]
Those above are not all the updates and fixes we're preparing for you. We'll keep updating you more frequently so you can see the progress.

[b]GAME RELEASE[/b]
The whole team is working extra hard. We're doing our best to release a great game for you as soon as possible. We want to make sure that once we give you a release date, it's 100% confirmed and the game will come out on that day. That's why for now we'd like to stick to [i]early 2019[/i]. We promise to update you as soon as we can :)

[b]BETA[/b]
Recently along with our publisher we've been sending some access codes to streamers to promote the game. If you'd like to get your hands on the game before the release, we've got some good news for you! We'd like to run a round of semi-open beta tests before the release. [b]More info coming soon![/b]

Thank you once more for keeping your fingers crossed for Cooking Simulator!
Regards,
Cooking Simulator Dev Team

notes.title: Update on release date
notes.content:
For the last couple of weeks a lot of fans have been showing us great support by actively participating in beta testing. [b]Thanks![/b] We've received tons of positive and constructive feedback. Based on it, we've decided to take a little more time to properly polish the game. As we've always said, we want to deliver a complete and enjoyable product that we can all be proud of.

The game will be released on [b]6th of December[/b] and it's going to contain:
- [b]over 60[/b] dishes to unlock
- [b]over 120[/b] ingredients and products
- [b]Career mode[/b] with 5 levels of fame to achieve  
- [b]Cooking School[/b], a full game tutorial
- [b]Sandbox mode[/b] where you can freely access full game content and do whatever you want

We understand that you've been waiting for Cooking Simulator for quite a while and we solemnly apologize for the delay. We hope that you'll understand that we're making this decision only to [b]deliver the best game we can possibly make[/b], the game you deserve.
